description: Physics-lumped phase-controlled cycloconverter: averaged output voltage vs firing angle, direct AC-AC synthesis of a low output frequency, lumped first-order output-current ODE driven into an R-L load, input displacement power factor (lagging) and harmonic content.
source: Pelly, B.R. (1971) Thyristor Phase-Controlled Converters and Cycloconverters, Wiley; Bose, B.K. (2002) Modern Power Electronics and AC Drives, Prentice Hall, ch. 4; Mohan, Undeland & Robbins (2003) Power Electronics 3rd ed., ch. 12.

p_pulse.note: Pulse number per converter group (6-pulse dual converter per output phase)

Lc_commutation.note: Source/commutation inductance per phase (overlap voltage drop)

alpha_min.note: Minimum firing angle (~5 deg) to guarantee successful firing

alpha_max.note: Maximum firing angle (~160 deg) inverter-limit to avoid commutation failure

f_out.note: Output frequency, must stay below ~1/3 of f_line for low harmonics

r_mod.note: Output voltage modulation ratio (fraction of max fundamental)
